final: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS staff_amount FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(staff_amount) AS total_amount FROM staff_totals) SELECT staff_totals.staff_id, staff_totals.staff_amount, staff_totals.staff_amount / CAST(grand_total.total_amount AS REAL) FROM staff_totals CROSS JOIN grand_total
